catalogClauses.base: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from 0.01 to 3.7 / 4.3 / 4.9 / 5.5 seconds, with bonus damage up to 180 added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
catalogClauses.super: Super: Sacred Arrow spawns 300 damage Starstorm meteors towards enemies within 500 radius of itself and on targets it hits. -2s cooldown.
catalogClauses.gaben: Gaben: +1 arrow on each side of the main Arrow. +200 Starstorm meteor damage.
